title.value: Bugs in Machine Learning-based Systems: A Faultload Benchmark
title.justification: The title accurately describes the focus of the paper on providing a benchmark for bugs in machine learning systems.
title.quote: Bugs in Machine Learning-based Systems: A Faultload Benchmark

extractions.description: This paper discusses the creation of a faultload benchmark, called defect4ML, which documents bugs in machine learning systems using TensorFlow and Keras. It addresses the reproducibility and verifiability of these bugs, providing a standard benchmark to evaluate ML-based systems' software reliability engineering practices.
